phrases.text: January 1. Leave a little room between those resolutions to lie down.
New year. Same fish. Hoping for gentler treatment from the universe.
Valentine's Day. Affection does not need expensive wrapping.
February 14. You can keep some of the kindness for yourself.
April Fools. I am full of ambition today. There. That's the joke.
April 1. No tricks. Being this flat is quite real.
June 1. A little room for play. It need not be productive. Like me.
June 1. Leave a corner for curiosity, not just more things to do.
Christmas Eve. Wishing your worries a slightly lower volume.
December 24. A little peace. No elaborate assembly required.
Merry Christmas. My good wishes come unwrapped. Less effort for everyone.
December 25. May one small thing today feel warm.
Last day of the year. Unfinished does not mean wasted.
December 31. A whole year does not have to fit on a scorecard.
February 29. An extra day, not an extra assignment.
Leap day. Even the calendar occasionally wants to linger.
The first again. The calendar refreshes faster than my enthusiasm.
New month. Starting slowly still qualifies as starting.
Happy Lunar New Year. Wishing you fewer unnecessary complications.
Lunar New Year. May there be plenty. I can contribute one fish.
Lantern Festival. Wishing things a rounder ending. I'll stay flat.
Lantern Festival. A small light of good wishes. No batteries needed.
Mid-Autumn Festival. The moon handles round. I handle flat.
Mid-Autumn. However you spend it, I hope there's a comfortable corner.
